text:
```yaml
name: Validate PR Title

on:
  pull_request:
    types:
      - opened
      - edited
      - synchronize

jobs:
  validate-pr-title:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: amannn/action-semantic-pull-request@v6
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        with:
          types: |
            feat
            fix
            docs
            style
            refactor
            perf
            test
            chore
            revert
            ci
            build
            deps
          requireScope: false
          subjectPattern: ^[a-z].+$
          subjectPatternError: |-
            The subject must start with a lowercase letter.
```
